response.sql: SELECT o.orderbase AS channel, AVG(oe.fillcount) AS avg_filled_quantity, COUNT(oe.orderexecmark) AS num_executions, COUNT(oe.orderexecmark) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orderexecutions oe2 INNER JOIN orders o2 ON oe2.ordersmark = o2.recordvault) AS fraction_of_total FROM orderexecutions oe INNER JOIN orders o ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderbase
